title: Export breaks on the second quote inside a field
prompt: The CSV export is importable again after one fix, except for values with MORE than one quote: a field like 'say "hi" now' comes back mangled on re-import. Per the RFC 4180 note in lib/csvw.mjs, EVERY quote inside a quoted field must be doubled. Fix lib/csvw.mjs and verify with your own script (quotes, commas, newlines, CR, null/undefined, numbers, multi-row, empty rows/fields) before answering.
